## Definition of Done

- [ ] PR title follows Conventional Commits (`type(scope): summary`)
- [ ] Small and focused (one concern, ~400 changed lines max)
- [ ] Code is typed and commented where the intent is not obvious
- [ ] Tests added or updated, and CI is green
- [ ] No secrets, real keys or personal data in code, tests or logs
- [ ] User-facing text in plain French, checked on a small screen
- [ ] Docs / ADR / `.env.example` updated if needed
